_comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs. Counts may only go DOWN. A rule at 0 should be deleted from this file so it becomes a hard error. Regenerate with: node scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs --update-baseline

counts._quantity-as-status: 10 is the EARNED-EXCEPTION set, not debt: the essay length meter (4 - a real limit you can exceed), the deadline urgency bars and dots (5), and the notification count dot (1, a presence test rather than a band). Every progress/completion bar that used to be here was converted in 77193fe. Hand-added because the rule is new; --update-baseline may only lower a number.
